sample_order: separate isolated A-B-B-A workers for each fixture; legacy, dag, dag, legacy
limitations: This exact source passed generated integration but failed native integration because its new module was absent from the explicit lake roots. Later descendants repaired the native root and local proof gates. Do not infer same-HEAD full qualification.
Ordinary complete-public-operation and admission measurements below are original JSON records extracted from job logs, with their original numeric representations preserved.

For public-operation records, check_ms is total across calls; for admission records, admission_ms is total across calls and excludes separately reported exact-result assertions. Input construction is separately reported.
The comparison is same-run V1 versus DAG, not a controlled pre-cache versus post-cache attribution.
Fresh semantic caches remain scoped to each public operation or admitted batch; kernel fuel was not raised.
Negative retained-heap deltas are GC observations, not proofs of lower allocation or retained memory.
No whole-kernel speedup or Arena timeout-resolution claim is supported by these finite fixtures.
